results.title: HP to get Rs 1,200 cr yearly from Kishau dam, won't invest: Negi
results.description: Himachal Pradesh minister Jagat Singh Negi said the state will get Rs 1,200 crore annually in revenue from the Kishau project without any investment, a deal he claimed was a major win compared to the one proposed under the previous BJP government.

results.title: Traders’ forum in Keralam to boycott UPI transactions on October 15
results.description: Traders in Kerala plan to boycott UPI transactions on October 15 to protest new government-imposed charges on digital payments.

results.title: Asian Games 2026: India's cricket team in semis, teqball eyes bronze
results.description: India's women's cricket team stormed into the Asian Games 2026 semifinals with an eight-wicket win over Japan. The teqball mixed doubles pair of Quimcy Joaquim Dsouza and Mohamed Anas Imran Beg also secured a spot in the bronze medal match.
